notes: Fixes plugins that were moved into the hub but still showed as running in DungeonHelper. If you run more than one DungeonHelper at once they were overwriting each other's record of which plugins had been moved, so most of them ended up moved on disk but forgotten. The hub no longer keeps that list — a plugin is in the hub if its folder is there, which nothing can overwrite — so everything already moved is picked up on the next restart. Other settings are now merged rather than overwritten, so two clients no longer undo each other. The All plugins page gained an On column and a Turn on/Turn off button, so you can see and change every plugin's state from one screen instead of visiting each page. Also fixed: moving a running plugin back out to DungeonHelper left its files behind (they're locked while loaded), which could leave it loaded twice — the leftovers are now cleared up after DungeonHelper closes.
